[LADP.8.4.2] **Every service declares its response** ([LGRA.23.1]), as one of:

| Declaration | A successful call | A failed call |
|---|---|---|
| `response T` | the adapter asserts one fact of `T` ([LCRS.4.3.1]) | a `CallError` ([LCRS.4.2.1]) |
| `no response` | nothing is asserted | a `CallError` |

A declaration with neither is a compile error
(`DS_VALIDATE_SERVICE_NO_RESPONSE_DECL`, [LGRA.23.2]): there is no untyped
response. A call to a `no response` service is [LCRS.17].
